title: Blocked Account, Health Insurance and Bank Account for your move to Germany
description: Moving to Germany? EC Assets bundles the three things your visa application needs, a Blocked Account, Health Insurance and a German Bank Account, into one online application. Fast, clear and fairly priced.

items.a: The {{product}} combines a Blocked Account, a German Bank Account and the health insurance your visa application requires, set up together in one application. The monthly fee covers the two accounts; the insurance premium goes to the insurer and is billed only after you arrive.

Everything happens online. Choose a product, answer a few questions so we can match the right insurance and account setup to your situation, and complete the application form. You receive your documents digitally and can download them for your visa appointment.

items.q: Can I get a Blocked Account without having the full amount?
items.a: Yes. Our partner banks fund the deposit and EC Assets pays the interest directly to the bank, so you repay only what you received. The eligibility check takes two minutes. More about the interest-free study loan.

blocks.html: Your EC Assets debit card can be added to Apple Pay and Google Pay, so you can pay by phone from the day you arrive.
